## About
Precision Tuning Motorsports is a Subaru shop on American Way in Spotswood, NJ. We handle maintenance, clutches, suspension, engine builds and tuning, and we've grown right along with the Subaru community.
Customers come to us from New Jersey, Pennsylvania, New York and beyond. Reviewers talk about Rich, Melo and the whole staff explaining the work clearly, sending updates while the car is in the shop, and never pushing repairs you don't need.
We also carry a large online catalog of Subaru parts. If you can't find what you're after, call us and we'll track it down. Rated 4.6 from 118 Google reviews.

## Services
- Tuning: Tuning for Subaru vehicles. Appointment required.
- Clutch installation: Labor for 6 speed clutch installs on WRX and STI with customer supplied parts. (Starting at $650)
- Short throw shifter installs: We install short throw shifter kits and walk you through the work before we start.
- Maintenance services: Complete maintenance services for your Subaru.
- Engine building: Complete engine builds for your Subaru.

## FAQ
Q: What's the fastest way to get a quote?
A: Fill out the work request form on our site. It puts your info and request straight into our system so estimating goes faster. Email and phone still work too.

Q: Do I need anything before a tune?
A: Yes. Please bring in a completed dyno waiver before any tuning can be done.

Q: Can you tune a car with emissions equipment removed?
A: No. We don't tune vehicles that have had their emission equipment removed, but your car can be tuned perfectly well with that equipment in place.

Q: Do you offer ECUTEK tuning?
A: Right now we offer ECUTEK tuning only on the FRS/BRZ platform.
